# biobb_vs

### Introduction
Biobb_vs is the Biobb module collection to perform virtual screening studies. Biobb (BioExcel building blocks) packages are Python building blocks that create new layer of compatibility and interoperability over popular bioinformatics tools.
The latest documentation of this package can be found in our readthedocs site:
[latest API documentation](http://biobb-vs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/).
